name: Do outdoor night lights require special electrical wiring?

mainEntity.name: Do outdoor night lights require special electrical wiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many outdoor night lights, particularly low-voltage systems and hardwired fixtures, do require specific electrical wiring. Low-voltage systems use a transformer to reduce household current, requiring dedicated low-voltage wiring. High-voltage fixtures need standard electrical wiring run by a licensed electrician, often involving trenching and weather-proof connections. Solar-powered night lights, however, typically do not require any new wiring, as they are self-contained. Our team ensures all installations comply with local electrical codes for safety and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardwired and low-voltage night lights require specific electrical wiring, often installed by an electrician. Solar lights do not need new wiring.
